The '''Trandoshani Hunters Alliance''' was an organization of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters that was active in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Hunters Alliance had issued a 30,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowdaar]] in revenge for the [[Death/Legends|death]] and "dishonor" of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Karssk]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshani Hunters Alliance was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
